# Parse the songs to archive from the file content
import re
content = file_data['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove the leading "- "
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split by " by " to get title and artist
        if ' by ' in song_str:
            title, artist = song_str.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            songs_to_archive.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist.strip()})
print(songs_to_archive)
